title: BTS Stanford Stadium Merchandise Opens; Fan Wave Documented by Bay Area Press — Stanford Debut Tomorrow
detail: On May 15, 2026 — Day 4,719 since BTS's June 13, 2013 debut — official Stanford Stadium merchandise sales open at the Hammer Throw area on Stanford's campus from 10 AM to 6 PM PDT. Weverse pre-order merchandise pickup is also available at 395 Quarry Rd, Palo Alto, CA, through May 19. Stanford/Live Nation report heavier-than-normal campus traffic throughout May 14–18 due to fan arrivals from across the US and internationally. The Mountain View Voice publishes 'BTS fans to flood Stanford this weekend for return tour,' documenting the ARMY community converging on the Bay Area in record numbers. Concert logistics: gates open 4:30 PM, shows begin 7:00 PM, with a strict clear-bag policy in effect. May 15 marks the last day before BTS's historic Stanford Stadium debut on May 16, when they become only the second musical act ever to perform at the 50,000-capacity venue — after Coldplay.

title: 'SWIM' Holds No. 1 on Billboard Global Excl. U.S.; Korea Herald Confirms BTS Among Global 200 Top 3
detail: The Billboard Global charts dated May 16, 2026 (published May 15) confirm BTS's lead single 'SWIM' holds at No. 1 on the Billboard Global Excl. U.S. chart and at No. 2 on the Billboard Global 200 for another week. Korea Herald reports on May 15 that BTS is among the top three acts on the Global 200 alongside Justin Bieber and Nicki Minaj. This represents 'SWIM''s continuation of an extended run near the top of global streaming charts — part of a multi-week stretch setting all-time K-pop records for Billboard Global chart longevity. ARIRANG continues charting on the Billboard 200 Top 10. The chart performance coincides with BTS's presence in the Bay Area ahead of Stanford Stadium shows, the one-day-old World Cup halftime show announcement, and a HYBE executive disclosure that former CHRO Kim Joo-young and former Hybe America CEO Scooter Braun have departed, with their shareholdings dropping to zero.

media.caption: 'SWIM' by BTS holds No. 1 on Billboard Global Excl. U.S. and No. 2 on Billboard Global 200 — May 16-dated charts (published May 15, 2026)
